description: the JSON dialect each reader accepts: trailing commas (KL003) in a data pack, a duplicate key (KL004), broken JSON (KL001), a BOM (KL005) and a comment (KL002) in a cook recipe, single quotes

diagnostics.message: strings use double quotes " in JSON
a UTF-8 byte-order mark: this file's reader (Python's json) refuses it
comments are not allowed: the cook tools read this file with Python's json module (plain JSON)
trailing comma: kiln.content / kiln.assets read this file with nlohmann::json, which allows comments but not trailing commas
duplicate key "maxStackSize": the later value is the one Kiln reads
